technical_and_design_decisions: For the @EnableModule annotation (U3), use Spring's existing @Import and BeanPostProcessor mechanisms to scan for @Input and @Output annotations and automatically create channel beans and adapters.
For Kryo optimization (U4), rely on existing optimization patterns and document guidelines as part of the codebase.
For moving serialization codec (U7), extract the relevant classes into Spring Integration (SI) as a separate module with backward compatibility.
For CloudController-based Admin SPI (U8), follow the architecture of previous spikes (XD-3194, XD-3229) and reuse ModuleLauncher from spring-cloud-data.
Use Maven for dependency management and building across all user stories.
assumptions: Developer has full familiarity with Spring Framework, Reactor, Kryo, Spring XD, and Cloud Foundry.
All required environments (e.g., EC2 for CI, Ambari cluster) are available and pre-configured.
No major breaking changes in Reactor 2.0.4 that require significant refactoring beyond updates.
Existing test suites and CI pipelines are in place and can be extended.
The user stories are for a single software increment and can be developed sequentially or in parallel with no dependencies except as noted.
